title: Derived category of quasi-coherent modules over a sheaf algebra
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $B$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra. Define $D(B)$ as the derived category of complexes of sheaves of $B$-modules, and define $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(B)$ as its full subcategory of complexes bounded below whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent $B$-modules. A quasi-coherent $B$-module means a $B$-module whose underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-module is quasi-coherent.
